title: Try, try again
hints: `await` inside a `try { ... } catch { ... }` turns a rejected promise into a normal catch — so a plain loop works.
Loop `attempts` times. On success, `return await fn()` immediately. On failure, remember the error and keep looping.
let last: unknown; for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) { try { return await fn(); } catch (e) { last = e; } } throw last;
